title: Common Data Format - Meta Data Schema
description:
**Version 0.3.2**

This schema defines the Meta Data as described in the [Common Data Format paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.15820).

format.description: Specifying the competition set-up such as league_18 (i.e., league involving 18 teams), league_20, knock_out_neutral, etc.

period.description: Period of the match which can be first_half, second_half, first_half_extratime, second_half_extratime, or shootout

play_direction.description: The direction of play for the home team. Possible options are left_right or right_left.

start_time.description: Start time of the period in UTC

end_time.description: End time of the period in UTC

frame_id_start.description: Frame identifier for the tracking data related to the start of the period

frame_id_end.description: Frame identifier for the tracking data related to the end of the period

left_team_id.description: Unique team identifier of the team playing on the left side of the pitch in this period. The CDF requires a standardized playing direction. The left_team_id and right_team_id should be the actual, non-standardized sides.

right_team_id.description: Unique team identifier of the team playing on the right side of the pitch in this period.

whistles.description: Whistles that start and end major periods of play

type.description: Whistles that start and end major periods of play such as the start and end of halves and interruptions (e.g., weather, VAR review, player health events, streakers or abandoned). Examples of types first_half, second_half, weather_delay, health_delay, injury_treatment fan_health_delay etc.

sub_type.description: Sub type related to an interruption, for example 'start' or 'end'

time.description: The time in UTC of the whistle

round.description: Round of the match (e.g. 1, 2, 3, final, semi_final)

country.description: Country where the match is played

city.description: City where the match is played

is_open_roof.description: Indicates if the roof is open (true) or closed (false)

precipitation.description: Precipitation during the match in millimetres

id.description: Unique identifier for the venue or stadium.

pitch_length.description: Length of the pitch in metres, null if not available

pitch_width.description: Width of the pitch in metres, null if not available

name.description: Name of the venue or stadium

turf.description: Information on the turf of the stadium (natural, natural_reinforced, grass, clay,...)

video.description: Video meta data information, null if not relevant

version.description: Version number for the video data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

name.description: Vendor name of the video data

fps.description: Frames per second (i.e., frame rate) of tracking, landmark tracking or video

event.description: Event data meta information, null if not relevant

collection_timing.description: Indicates if the event data was collected 'live' or 'post_match'.

name.description: Vendor name of the event data

version.description: Version number for the event data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

tracking.description: Tracking data meta information, null if not relevant

version.description: Version number for the tracking data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

name.description: Vendor name of the tracking data

fps.description: Frames per second (i.e., frame rate) of tracking, landmark tracking or video

collection_timing.description: Indicates if the tracking data was collected 'live' or 'post_match'.

landmarks.description: Landmark tracking data meta information, null if not relevant

version.description: Version number for the landmark data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

name.description: Vendor name of the landmark tracking data

fps.description: Frames per second (i.e., frame rate) of tracking, landmark tracking or video

collection_timing.description: Indicates if the landmark data was collected 'live' or 'post_match'.

skeleton.description: Skeletal hierarchy used: which landmarks are tracked and how they are connected. Required when landmark data is provided. Every name here is a landmark name from the landmark data.

root.description: Name of the landmark the hierarchy is rooted at

joints.description: Names of every landmark in the hierarchy

connections.description: Parent-child pairs describing how the landmarks connect

ball.description: Ball tracking data meta information, null if not relevant. Only relevant when providing an independent ball file.

version.description: Version number for the ball data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

name.description: Vendor name of the ball data

fps.description: Frames per second (i.e., frame rate) of ball tracking

collection_timing.description: Indicates if the ball data was collected 'live' or 'post_match'.

version.description: Version number for the data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

name.description: Vendor name of the meta data

version.description: Version number for the data collection in use (e.g. '0.1.0')

first_name.description: First name of the official, null if not available

last_name.description: Last name of the official, null if not available

short_name.description: Short name of the official, null if not available

id.description: Unique identifier for the home or away team

team_id.description: Unique team identifier denoting the team the player plays for

is_starter.description: Denotes whether a player started the game (true) or not (false)

last_name.description: Last name of the player, null if not available

first_name.description: First name of the player, null if not available

players.description: Array of player objects. One array under teams/home, one array under teams/away

jersey_colour.description: Jersey colour of the team as a hexadecimal color code (e.g. #545B62).
